newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DSM Resins forms Chinese joint venture.
newsitem.headline: DSM Resins forms Chinese joint venture.

text.p: Dutch chemicals group DSM said on Thursday its DSM Resins unit had reached a preliminary agreement with Taiwan's Eternal Chemicals to form a 50:50 joint venture producing and selling coating resins in the People's Republic of China.
"The new venture, DSM Eternal Resins Kunshan Ltd. Co., will build a production installation for coating resins with a capacity of 12,000 tonnes in Kunshan, near Shanghai," it said in a statement.
It said the plant would require an investment of some 15 million guilders and would come on line in autumn 1998.

DSM Resins' Coating Resins business unit already has plants in Europe, the USA and -- in a joint venture with Eternal -- in Taiwan and said it aims to have production facilities in every major geographical market.

"By building a new plant in China in a joint venture with Eternal we will be better able to acquire substantial positions in this rapidly expanding Chinese market than if we continued to import our products into this region," said Coating Resins director Bernard van Schaik.
